profile_text.body:
Together AI, founded in 2022, describes itself as an "AI Native Cloud" offering a full-stack platform for inference, fine-tuning, and GPU clusters. The company's site positions it as infrastructure for building with open-source AI models, with services including a serverless inference API, managed object storage and parallel filesystems optimized for AI workloads, and GPU infrastructure aimed at generative media applications such as video, audio, and image model deployment. The platform is described as capable of scaling to 30 billion tokens per model, and the company emphasizes zero egress fees on its storage offering.

Together AI has raised $800 million, which it describes as intended to accelerate the shift to open-source AI, arguing on its site that the economics of closed models do not scale. Its research activities involve collaborators from institutions including Princeton University, Carnegie Mellon University, UC Berkeley, NVIDIA, and Meta, with Tri Dao listed as affiliated with both Princeton University and Together AI. The site's tracked product entry notes capabilities including a decentralized cloud for open models, an inference API, a model hub, and data residency options.
